payload.reason: The evidence provides specific evaluation criteria and metrics used to assess the generated text, including WER and BLEU scores, as well as human evaluations for usability.

claims.text: The word error rate (WER) is used as a metric to evaluate the generated text, measuring the number of insertions, substitutions, and deletions compared to a reference.
The BLEU score is another metric used, with the model achieving a score of 19.67 on the test set.
Human evaluation was conducted to assess the acceptability of the output for production use, focusing on usability for a news channel.
